references.text: Carmel is mentioned as an area in connection with the kings that Joshua defeated, referring to the same geographical region near Mount Carmel.
Carmel is mentioned as the place where Elijah confronted the prophets of Baal, the same mountainous region bordering Asher's territory.
The context for the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, which includes the cities mentioned in verse 26.
Manasseh's inheritance also mentions border areas with Asher, including nearby cities.
